newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-COURBIS INSISTING ON ONE-YEAR DEAL AT MARSEILLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-COURBIS INSISTING ON ONE-YEAR DEAL AT MARSEILLE.

text.p: Marseille's much-publicised plans to sign Bordeaux coach Rolland Courbis are faltering over the length of contract he is prepared to sign.

Former European champions Marseille, currently wallowing in mid-table and anxious to regain their status as France's leading team, have announced countless times that Courbis is to join them next season.
But the coach, emphatically denying a deal had been concluded, said on Thursday night: "If I go to Marseille, it will be with a contract for one year.
"If the (Marseille) president Robert Louis-Dreyfus accepts my proposal then I'll consider going.

"I was very flattered when Marseille offered me a five year contract," Courbis said. "I know Louis-Dreyfus did not favour a duration of one year. But at 43 I don't want to embark on a career as a civil servant."
Bordeaux said they were surprised to learn that Courbis, who signed with them for a year, was considering a Marseille offer and claimed they were involved in talks for him to stay on.
Courbis built an almost completely new side at Bordeaux who reached the League Cup final and are fourth in the first division.
